children: The USDA has announced another round of flash sales of U.S. grain exports. The agency says that 272,000 metric tons of soybeans have been sold to China for delivery in the 2026/27 marketing year, while an additional 206,500 tons of soybeans were reported as being "received" by the USDA for delivery to unknown destinations, also for 2026/27. It's the second flash sale to China reported in the shortened holiday week, with the first being 340,000 tons of soybeans sold to China reported on Tuesday. CBOT grains are higher pre-market, with corn up 0.8%, soybeans up 0.8%, and wheat up 0.7%. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
